description: Deterministic rule-based technical indicator configurations and signal thresholds.

rules.name: ema_9_above_ema_21
rules.description: Fast EMA (9) is strictly above slow EMA (21), indicating upward short-term momentum.

rules.name: ema_9_below_ema_21
rules.description: Fast EMA (9) is strictly below slow EMA (21), indicating downward short-term momentum.

rules.name: price_above_ema_50
rules.description: Close price is above intermediate trend EMA (50).

rules.name: price_below_ema_50
rules.description: Close price is below intermediate trend EMA (50).

rules.name: rsi_bullish_momentum
rules.description: RSI is in bullish expansion zone (50 < RSI < 70).

rules.name: rsi_bearish_momentum
rules.description: RSI is in bearish contraction zone (30 < RSI < 50).

rules.name: rsi_oversold_reversal
rules.description: RSI is below oversold threshold (<= 30), signaling mean-reversion long potential.

rules.name: rsi_overbought_reversal
rules.description: RSI is above overbought threshold (>= 70), signaling mean-reversion short potential.

rules.name: macd_bullish_cross
rules.description: MACD line is strictly above MACD signal line.

rules.name: macd_bearish_cross
rules.description: MACD line is strictly below MACD signal line.

rules.name: price_above_vwap
rules.description: Close price is above rolling intraday VWAP.

rules.name: price_below_vwap
rules.description: Close price is below rolling intraday VWAP.

rules.name: bb_lower_bounce
rules.description: Close price is near or below lower Bollinger Band (%B <= 0.10).

rules.name: bb_upper_rejection
rules.description: Close price is near or above upper Bollinger Band (%B >= 0.90).
